function.name: get_change_type_guidance
function.description: Determines whether a personal data change is ESS (self-service) or requires HR Service Center (complex). Returns the process steps, required documentation, timeline, and deep link.

change_type.description: The type of personal data change

function.name: screen_grievance
function.description: Screens a workplace concern to determine if it should be routed to formal ERLR (serious misconduct) or informal GOOS (everyday workplace issues). Returns the recommended path, process overview, and deep link.

concern_summary.description: Brief summary of the employee workplace concern

involves_misconduct.description: Whether the concern involves harassment, discrimination, retaliation, threats, ethical violations, or other serious misconduct

concern_category.description: Category that best describes the concern

function.name: search_hr_knowledge_base
function.description: Searches the HR knowledge base for policy information, procedures, guidelines, and FAQs from SharePoint and ServiceNow. Use when employee asks about HR policies, benefits, or procedures not directly covered in your instructions.

query.description: Search query for HR documents and policies

top_results.description: Number of results to return (default 3, max 5)

metadata.description: HR Concierge - Contoso AI HR assistant for personal data changes and grievance screening
